description: This file defines auxiliary functions, macros, and constants for manipulating prototypes and closures in the Lua 5.3.8 implementation. It includes function declarations for creating and managing closures, upvalues, and function prototypes, as well as macros for size calculations and status checks.

methods.name: luaF_newproto
methods.description: Creates a new Proto object representing a Lua function's prototype.

methods.name: luaF_newCclosure
methods.description: Creates a new C closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_newLclosure
methods.description: Creates a new Lua closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_initupvals
methods.description: Initializes the upvalues for a Lua closure.

methods.name: luaF_findupval
methods.description: Finds or creates an upvalue at the given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_newtbcupval
methods.description: Creates a new to-be-closed upvalue at the specified stack level.

methods.name: luaF_closeupval
methods.description: Closes an upvalue at the given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_close
methods.description: Closes all open upvalues above a certain stack level.

methods.name: luaF_unlinkupval
methods.description: Removes an upvalue from the list of open upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_freeproto
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a Proto object.

methods.name: luaF_getlocalname
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a local variable at a specific program counter.
